definitions.explanation: Referring to every individual separately within a group.

examples.japanese: {銘々|めいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧ものを⟦{選|えら}んでください→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Each person please choose what you like.

examples.japanese: {銘々|めいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}きたい→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I want to hear each person's opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銘々|めいめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}いましょう→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: Let's each pay our own expenses.

examples.japanese: {銘々|めいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{物|もの}→持ち物：03165_mochimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いてください→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on each of your belongings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銘々|めいめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: For lunch, each person went to a restaurant of their choice.

notes:
{銘々|めいめい} means 'each person' or 'individually,' emphasizing that every member of a group acts or is considered separately.

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
Can also be written as ⟦{各々|おのおの}→各々：00334_onoono⟧ (same meaning, more formal) or {銘銘|めいめい} (simplified).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {銘々|めいめい}が + verb (each person does ~)
- {銘々|めいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (each person's ~)
- {銘々|めいめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb (each on their own)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧ (each person - formal)
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧ (each; respectively)
- ⟦{各々|おのおの}→各々：00334_onoono⟧ (each one - literary)
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧ (separately)

USAGE:
{銘々|めいめい} emphasizes individual responsibility or choice. It's slightly more casual than ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧ but more formal than ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧.
